configuration: A deterministic reduced configuration derived from test/dfm.jl with 1 graded timestep(s).
observable: matrix/fracture centroids, pore volumes, and fracture permeability
default_vs_upstream: reduced spatial or temporal size while preserving the official production path
variant: one input changes from 0.001 to its adjacent Float64 value 0.0010000000000000002
altbuild: none: Julia 1.11.9 is the pinned supported runtime and the source package has no independent alternative native build

comparison.rule: Compare every Float64 value in matrix/fracture centroids, pore volumes, and fracture permeability in documented array order using abs(candidate-reference) <= 1e-10 + 1e-8*abs(reference).

evidence.floor_how: two independent Docker nominal solves (20260916T233732Z and 20260917T000633Z) compared with validate.py were byte-identical

warrant: The bound grades fracture geometry and rock properties directly. Two independent Docker nominal solves had zero spread, while the approved aperture variant used 1.35e-10 of the bound. A 1e-4 relative wrong-output probe was rejected.
